title: skills(pm-dispatch): a describing text that disagrees with an unruled implementation is a docs fix in the queue, never a decision card
body:
Fixes #17031

## What changed

One rule — **a describing text that disagrees with an implementation which has not itself been ruled wrong is a documentation defect: the text moves, in `pm:queue`, and the card never enters the decision box** — landed as seven in-place line rewrites across the three files where its readers sit. Zero net lines; every file stays exactly at its ratchet ceiling (no raise, no re-wrap funding); every rewritten line is at or under 120 bytes; no issue ids, dates or quotations in operational text (provenance is below, in this body, where it belongs).

The boundary that decides which side moves is **provenance**. A sentence with a ruled provenance (an ADR, the spec, a maintainer ruling) that the implementation departs from is finding class (b) — a contract violation — and the implementation moves; SKILL.md:729 「协议为基准:spec 与代码不一致默认改代码对齐」 already says so and is untouched. A sentence with no such provenance — a JSDoc `@default`, a README line, a reference page, a docblock, a default copied from somewhere else — is a description, and the description moves. Neither side needs a decision card.

What still goes to the box is unchanged: a genuine design fork (SKILL.md:712 「选项在产品语义或公开契约形状上真实分歧且既有规范定不了」 and SKILL.md:645 「真正设计分叉照旧进决策箱」, both untouched). The new lines are guarded twice against being read as 「碰到就自裁」: the routing line carries 实现未被裁错 (an implementation someone has ruled wrong is the other branch), and the director's return runs through the existing class-1 self-ruling gate (SKILL.md:403–410), whose criterion ① 「既有裁定/在案类规则/成文纪律机械决定方向」 fails exactly when two readings are both reasonable — that card stays in the box and is presented.

## Every rewritten line, its bytes, and who reads it

| file:line | before | after | reader, and when |

| `SKILL.md:344` (77 B) | `- 碰存量数据迁移形状或删除已发布能力的卡也进决策箱。` | `- 碰迁移形状或删已发布能力也进决策箱;说明书脱节不进:有裁定出处才是 (b),否则改文档。` (120 B) | **triage seat**, same block — the `needs-user-decision` = … exclusion, and the finding-class (b) boundary the card asked for (说明书脱节 ≠ (b) unless the sentence has a ruled provenance) |
| `SKILL.md:714` (109 B) | `- 具名不升级类(立即行动):恢复不变量的修复;技术任务间的顺序与依赖;验证策略。` | `- 具名不升级类(立即行动):恢复不变量;技术任务间顺序与依赖;验证策略;说明书脱节。` (113 B) | **dispatching seat**, when a dev's `needs_decision` report is reviewed against the named non-escalation classes (SKILL.md:715, the very next line: 「dev 的 needs_decision 经 PM 复核落进不升级类的,PM 直接答复不上传」) |
| `core-rules.md:86` (85 B) | `- 有落点或可复现的具体缺陷与范围明确的工具修复进 \`pm:queue\`。` | `- 有落点或可复现的缺陷、范围明确的工具修复与实现未被裁错的说明书脱节进 \`pm:queue\`。` (118 B) | twin of SKILL.md:342 — SKILL.md:44 「一条规则在本文与核心条款一处改动,另一处同 PR 同改」 |
| `core-rules.md:87` (111 B) | `- 设计卡、契约形状提案、碰迁移形状或删已发布能力的进决策箱,落卡即带四棱块。` | `- 设计卡、契约形状提案、碰迁移形状或删已发布能力的进决策箱;无出处说明书脱节不进。` (120 B) | twin of SKILL.md:344 |
| `core-rules.md:137` (102 B) | `- 具名不升级类:恢复不变量的修复、技术任务之间的顺序与依赖、验证策略。` | `- 具名不升级类:恢复不变量的修复、技术任务之间的顺序与依赖、验证策略、说明书脱节。` (120 B) | twin of SKILL.md:714 |
| `lanes/director.md:48` (69 B) | `- 不达档 ⇒ 通道整体跳过,卡走维护者路径,恒安全。` (deleted) | `- 入箱先退回:实现未被裁错的说明书脱节卡按一类自裁录裁转 \`pm:queue\` 修文档,⛔ 不呈批。` (119 B) | **director seat**, at decision-box entry (职责二 决裁勤务) — before a card is placed into a five-card batch; it sits directly under line 47, which points at the self-ruling gates the return applies |

Consistency across the two homes, from the tree: `git grep -n 说明书脱节 -- .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/` answers exactly the seven lines above (SKILL.md 342/344/714, core-rules.md 86/87/137, director.md 48) and nothing else — same term, same guard (实现未被裁错 / 无出处), same routing (`pm:queue`, 修文档, 不进决策箱) in both files.

## What was deleted or trimmed to pay for it (headroom was 0 on all three files)

- **director.md:48 deleted** — 「不达档 ⇒ 通道整体跳过,卡走维护者路径,恒安全」 was stated three times: director.md:14 (「不达档只做免档整理 … 四职停放,⛔ 不裁不清标」), SKILL.md:400 (「档位未达 ⇒ 本 fire 代裁整体跳过,卡原样留在决策箱走维护者路径」) and core-rules.md:95. It also sat directly under director.md:47's own 「⛔ 不另抄」. The other two copies stay.
- **core-rules.md:87 drops 「落卡即带四棱块」** — restated verbatim at core-rules.md:146 (「每张决策卡落卡即带标准四棱块」) and SKILL.md:345; the core file's own subset invariant holds.
- **SKILL.md:344**: 「碰存量数据迁移形状或删除已发布能力的卡」 → 「碰迁移形状或删已发布能力」 — the spelling core-rules.md:87 already uses for the same clause.
- **SKILL.md:714**: 「恢复不变量的修复」 → 「恢复不变量」, 「技术任务间的顺序与依赖」 → 「技术任务间顺序与依赖」 — class names, no content moved.
- **core-rules.md:86**: 「具体缺陷」 → 「缺陷」 (「有落点或可复现」 already carries the concreteness).
- Not touched, no reader there: `references/lanes/triage.md` (7/7) is a pointer charter to SKILL.md 分诊座位职责; `references/decision-analysis.md` (50/50) governs how an analysis is written, not whether a card gets one. `SKILL.md:347` (the (b) definition) and `:349` (the (a) boundary) are untouched, so the dev-side twin `.claude/agents/os-dev.md:42` stays consistent.

## Line budget

Rewritten-line widths: 115 / 120 / 113 / 118 / 120 / 120 / 119 bytes (cap 120). `check:pm-skill-ratchet` on the final head: 「SKILL.md is 812 lines (ceiling 812; headroom 0)」, 「core-rules.md is 151 lines (ceiling 151; headroom 0)」, 「director.md is 72 lines (ceiling 72; headroom 0)」.

## Four-axis check on the wording

- **Real business need** — measured, not imagined: the ruling came from a live decision batch where a card of exactly this shape (two `@default true` JSDoc tags copied from an older zod default, actual default `false`) had been escalated to the maintainer; each such card costs one presentation slot and a maintainer read. The rule removes that class from the box at triage, at the dispatching seat's `needs_decision` review, and at the director's entry.
- **Long-term soundness** — the boundary is stated in the corpus's own existing vocabulary (「裁定出处」, 「(b)」, 「一类自裁」, 「协议为基准」) and reuses the existing escalation threshold and self-ruling gate rather than adding a parallel channel; no new label, no new state.
- **AI-authoring safety** — the failure mode an AI seat is most likely to produce is the opposite one (「文档说 X 所以代码错」): the guard 实现未被裁错 and the provenance test make a JSDoc line unable to convict an implementation on its own, while a sentence with a ruled provenance still convicts it as class (b). Loud direction: a card that is neither is a design fork and is presented, never quietly self-ruled.
- **Startup-stage focus** — no new surface, zero net lines, seven in-place rewrites; the corpus does not grow.

## Provenance

Maintainer, live conversation with the director seat, 2026-09-09, on objectui#8318 (「结构性(说明书与实现脱节)」), verbatim and untranslated:

> 所有这种文档错的都应该改文档,没有什么好决裁的,这个应该写入技能。

The boundary's two precedents, as the card gave them: objectui#8318 — `@default` tags copied from an older default, seven tags nobody renders; the ruling changed the tags, not the components. objectstack#16549 — Setup-page copy promising 「connect as yourself」 against an engine doing an intersection; the maintainer changed the engine, because that sentence *was* the ruled intent (ADR-0090 D10). The first has no provenance behind the sentence; the second does. That difference is the rule's boundary.

## Acceptance notes

- noted, not filed: the published `skills/objectstack-pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` (lines 204–207) carries a deliberately generalized Auto-queue / Maintainer-confirm criteria pair without this rule; that copy is generalized by design (route B in the frame-sync gate's header) and outside this card's file surface. 承接者:无 — the skills lane would own it only if the maintainer wants the rule shipped to third-party projects.
- noted, not filed: `.claude/agents/os-dev.md:42` states class (b) as 「违背已声明契约(引契约原文)」; unchanged and consistent, because SKILL.md:347 was not touched and the provenance boundary lives on SKILL.md:344. 承接者:无.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么**:把您 9 月 9 日对 objectui#8318 的裁定写进 PM 技能:说明书类文本(JSDoc `@default`、README、参考文档、docblock)与实现不一致、而实现本身没有被裁为错的卡,一律当文档缺陷进队列修文档,不再进决策箱。三个席位各在自己读的位置看到同一条规则:分诊席在定级判据行(`pm:queue` = … / `needs-user-decision` = …),派发席在「具名不升级类」,总监席在决策箱入口的退回条款。分界写成「有裁定出处才是契约违背」:句子背后有 ADR、spec 或您的裁决 ⇒ 实现错,修实现;没有、只是描述(含抄来的默认值)⇒ 文档错,修文档;两边都不需要决策卡。

**为什么改**:您的原话:「所有这种文档错的都应该改文档,没有什么好决裁的,这个应该写入技能。」在此之前这类卡会被立成决策卡等您拍板,每张占您一次呈报和一次阅读;objectui#8318 就是这样到您面前的。

**风险与代价(含回滚)**:三个文件都顶在行数上限,所以全部原地改写、零新增行。为此付了三笔:删了 director.md 里一句在三处重复的「不达档就整体跳过」(另两处原样保留);把「落卡即带四棱块」从核心条款第 87 行去掉(第 146 行原样保留同一句);把几处措辞压短(「碰存量数据迁移形状或删除已发布能力的卡」→「碰迁移形状或删已发布能力」,与核心条款同拼写)。误判风险在反方向:真正的设计分叉(两种读法都说得通、或改哪边都动公开契约)不在此规则内 —— 升级门槛与「真正设计分叉照旧进决策箱」两行未动,总监席的退回走既有的一类自裁门,机械定不了方向的卡照旧呈报。回滚 = revert 本 PR 的一个 commit,不碰任何代码或数据。

**席位意见**:

**你要做的**:受管面,人工合并。请看一眼措辞是否与您本意一致,尤其是「有裁定出处才是 (b)」这条分界,以及「说明书脱节」进「具名不升级类」是否合您意。
